description: Ministry of Lands - Appointed Mr. S. Kanewela and N. B. I. Nanayakkara as Acquiring Officers for the Elavated Highway Project - New Kelani Bridge to Athurugiriya
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It appoints Acquisition Officers for the purpose of expediting land acquisitions for the Elevated Highway Project, which falls under land and property-related administrative matters. While it mentions appointments of specific individuals, the primary focus is on land acquisition processes and authority assignments for property matters, making it a Land Gazette rather than a government personnel classification.
